If you don't do this, you won't be able to put in your best efforts to achieve your goals as you will lose a lot of energy.

title: 12 important rules that will make your life easier
text: **1. Keep your promises.** Make it a habit to always keep your promises. If you promised to call back, call back! They promised to do something - do it! Do not spoil your reputation with unfulfilled promises and remember this rule forever! **2. Are you late? Be warned about this!** It’s also an important healthy habit that you shouldn’t forget about. Always warn when you are late or something else is out of your control. **3. Never laugh at other people's dreams!** This destroys a person and his attitude towards you! Don’t destroy other people’s dreams, think about it before you say anything, put yourself in his place, because when your dreams are ridiculed, it’s very unpleasant. In one word you can kill! **4. Do not return to those who betrayed you.** As a rule, if a person betrayed you once, then it will not be difficult for him to do it a second time, and most likely he will do it. Betrayal leaves a deep wound, would you like to get it again? **5. Spend more time with your parents.** Spend as much time as possible with your parents - the moment when they are gone always comes unexpectedly. Don't forget about them, they will always be glad to see you, and when they are gone, you will regret that you were always busy for them. **6. Be polite.** As they say, politeness conquers cities, so never forget to be polite to everyone, use it as often as possible. **7. Admit your mistakes.** Many people do not know how to admit their mistakes. They always blame others for everything. Parents that they were sent to the wrong university, the government that it doesn’t have enough money, millionaires that they are millionaires, etc. Learn to take the blame on yourself, this is a very useful skill. **8. Stop whining!** Do you yourself like people who, from the very beginning of the conversation, start talking about their problems, how bad everything is, etc.? Personally, I don’t like them and I wouldn’t want to be like that, so give up the habit of whining, think positively, then the world will become a better place in your eyes. **9. Don’t touch someone’s nerves.** Even in a serious quarrel, never try to insult a person, because most likely you will make peace, and the words spoken will be remembered for a long time. And again I repeat - words can kill! **10. Tell the truth.** Always tell the truth, there are many advantages to this. For example, by telling only the truth, you will need to be able to remember and you will avoid many quarrels. **11. Do the hardest thing at the beginning of the day.** When you do it, the rest of the day you will not be overwhelmed by unnecessary, negative thoughts that can ruin your day. Also, after a difficult task, work becomes easier. **12. Nobody owes anyone anything!** Forget forever the word must, otherwise you will definitely become mired in material and moral debts to someone. You live your life and you don’t owe anyone anything, just like other people.

title: 8 games our brain plays
text: **1. I would be happier if I had to work less.** Our mind often resorts to this argument, claiming that we would be happier if we didn't have to work. We imagine a life full of entertainment and are deceived into thinking that this would make us happier. However, idleness is often the main cause of boredom and depression. We are hardworking, creative creatures. We must solve problems and improve ourselves in order to be happy. Invest your soul in something meaningful to yourself, and you will see how your level of happiness has risen! **2. It's not me, it's all of them.** Our mind tries to make us believe that the cause of our unhappiness is in other people: acquaintances, spouses, parents... We are ready to throw accusations left and right, like a child throws toys in kindergarten. Of course, it takes two to tango - as we blame others, they blame us. The moment when we take responsibility for our lives will serve as the foundation of true happiness. **3. In order to be happy, I need to discover the secret of happiness.** The secret is that there are no secrets to happiness or success. No matter how much books, authors and our own minds convince us, there are no secret keys to the door of Simple Human Happiness. You yourself create a picture of your future, formulate a strategy and then persistently and diligently work to implement it. There are no shortcuts here. Accepting this fact will take you much further along the path of happiness. **4. If I had...** Our brain tries to convince us that we would be happier if we had a different job, a different house, a different car... There is nothing wrong with wanting better things and circumstances, but this does not make us automatically happy. They can temporarily lift your spirits, but this all passes quickly. Anyone who wants lasting happiness must realize that the barrel of desires is bottomless and can never be filled to the top. And true happiness comes from within... **5. I love what is and don’t want changes.** By allowing ourselves to think this way, we create all the prerequisites for falling down. Life is a journey of constant change. Some of them we control, some we don’t. Resistance to change or an attempt to take control of everything is doomed to failure. Change is inevitable. You must accept this and learn to swim in the continuous flow of change. Adaptability is very important for happiness. **6. If not today, then never.** Our mind often falls into despair and succumbs to disappointment a few steps away from success. Perseverance is very important to achieve happiness. Never allow your mind to deceive you and accept defeat. You don't know what tomorrow will bring you. Just one day may be all it takes to achieve your dreams. **7. I will make a decision when I know exactly what to do.** The more you think, the sooner you reach a dead end. Weighing risks, analyzing opportunities and adopting a plan are important factors, but nothing happens until there is a decision and action. We very rarely have complete information to make decisions. Stop doubts! Failure is not the end of the world. Don't let your mind lead you into the trap of total analysis of everything in the world. **8. I know I shouldn’t, but...** Our mind tries to deceive us by denying the consequences of our bad habits. This is especially true for health issues. “I know I shouldn’t smoke, but it helps me lose weight.” Or: “I know I shouldn’t eat this, but if I can’t enjoy life, then why live at all.” Health problems are certainly a challenge to happiness. Don't let your mind catch you in the trap of self-justification and indulgence in your weaknesses. ‍ ‍‍

title: 12 things confident people DON'T DO
text: **1. They don’t make excuses.** These people are not trying to avoid responsibility for their words and actions. They don't use excuses like "I just didn't have time." They admit their mistakes and try to correct them. **2. They don’t refuse to do things that scare them.** Don't let fear enslave you. They know that often the actions they are afraid to do are necessary steps towards achieving their goals. **3. Don't stay too long in your comfort zone.** They know that staying in their comfort zone is not productive. There is no room for progress in the comfort zone. **4. Don't put things off until next week.** Confident people understand that a good plan executed today is better than a great plan executed “someday.” **5. Don't get hung up on the opinions of others.** Don’t let yourself get bogged down by negative reviews from others. Of course, they care about the well-being of others, but at the same time they do not allow their opinions to negatively affect their own productivity. **6. Don't judge people.** Confident people do not feel the need to talk about others behind their backs or attack those whose opinions do not coincide with their own. **7. Don't let a lack of resources stop them from achieving their goals.** Confident people use the opportunities, even the smallest ones, that they have now, and do not waste time and energy complaining about the fact that they do not have all the necessary conditions for self-realization. **8. Don't compare yourself to others.** They do not compete with anyone other than themselves. **9. They don’t try to please everyone.** Confident people know that not all people get along. Therefore, they focus on the quality of the relationship rather than the quantity. **10. Don’t run away from solving problems.** Confident people understand that problems cannot be solved on their own. And if the problem is not solved now, it will most likely only grow over time. **11. They are not stopped by failures.** They know that only those who do nothing do not make mistakes, and that there is no progress without failures. **12. They don’t wait for permission to take action.** They do not wait for advice or a sign from above. They themselves are able to determine when to start.

title: Do a lot of things and not feel tired? It's quite possible!
text: **1. Get into the habit of planning the week's activities. ** One person, the head of a large company, shared: "When I started writing plans, I caught myself thinking that I stopped worrying about work. Everything is written down on paper, I won't forget anything - why bother?". The easiest way to plan: on Monday before you start work, write down all the things you need to do for the week, and then divide them by day. A new thing came up - put it on your list right away and think about when you'll get it done. **2. Try to combine your to-do's so that you have more time. ** For example, if you need to do several field trips - combine them in one day, then the rest of the time you will be able to work in the office. **3. Make a picture of the day.** A plan will only work if you, at least in your imagination, make sure it is realistic. Imagine the moment you arrive at work, what you will do first, what you will do later, will you have enough time to accomplish everything you have planned? If you feel that you have more things to do than time - reconsider your schedule. The plan should be realistic. **4. Plan for regular rests. ** Several short rests are better than one long rest. Apart from weekends, give yourself small rests during the day: lunch breaks, walks to the subway, short ten-minute breaks every hour at work. The alternation of things to do is also a kind of rest. Print an article, negotiate, go to the post office for a package. We have done three things, but there is no fatigue, because the cases are all different: while writing an article - worked head, when talking to a client - connected emotions, when we went to the post office - worked body. **5. Do sports. ** Sports activities are not an additional waste of time. It is a vacation, a way to unwind, lift your spirits and gain vigor for the next day. Dancing, martial arts, fitness, exercise in the morning will be a great addition to your schedule. **6. Work with music.** Almost all regular work does not require extreme concentration and then you can work with music. Oddly enough, you get tired a lot less. **7. Write long-term plans. ** The more areas of work, the more long-term plans should be. This will help to avoid overtime.

title: Why your business could be losing money
text: Just as all living organisms need water, businesses need money to thrive. And if a company is rapidly losing money, there is clearly something wrong with its business. The reasons why businesses lose money are: **1. You are not keeping track of your expenses. ** If this point applies to you, don't feel bad - you'd be surprised how many companies don't keep track of their expenses for utilities, salaries and rent. For businesses, however, this can be a big problem, as at some point you may start spending more than you earn and not find out about it. How to treat it: Gather all of your spending information for the last 6 months and start tracking your spending on a monthly basis. When you summarize at the end of the month, you'll be able to figure out what you can save money on. **2. Your credit card debts have been outstanding for a long time. ** Credit card debt is serious business. High interest on debt will not contribute in any way to the success of your venture. Credit cards can be a useful tool for paying your business's immediate expenses and earning bonuses, but if you don't manage your debts on time, your business will start losing money extremely quickly. How to treat it: Paying off credit card debt should be your number one priority. Start by increasing your monthly installments, and if the debts are too high, start seriously redirecting your budget in their direction. **3. You don't have a rainy day fund. ** Having a rainy day fund is essential not only for businesses, but for almost all citizens. Unforeseen situations happen to everyone, and when it comes to business, it is possible that such a situation will deprive you of the opportunity to earn money to solve it. How to treat: So that you don't have to make bad decisions in desperation if a force majeure does happen, your business needs an emergency fund. Make it so that a small portion of your profits are automatically deposited into a special account for emergencies. **4. You don't bargain. ** Regular buyers rarely get to haggle over the price of a desired product or service, but in the B2B world, it happens all the time. If you're not haggling with potential service providers, vendors and partners, or getting special discounts and bonuses, you're simply giving money away for nothing. How to treat: Always make a counteroffer. Never be afraid to ask a vendor for a 5% or 10% discount. If they turn you down, you're better off finding new partners anyway. **5. You are jealous of your competitors.** Has your friend's business recently moved to a luxurious office in a skyscraper? Are all your competitor's employees armed with the latest gadgets? Is the furniture in the contractor's office several times better than what is in your office? These are all understandable reasons to be jealous, but they don't mean your business is doing worse than your wasteful competitors. But if you start thoughtlessly spending money on such toys, your business may even become ill. How to treat: Remember, always buy only what your business needs, not what you want. Used furniture and rental equipment can just as impress potential partners, investors or clients without leaving a hole in your pocket. **6. Paydays make you nervous.** After taxes, salaries are perhaps the main expense item for your business. If you are not sure whether you can pay an employee’s salary, then your company has serious financial problems, which may soon develop into legal problems. How to treat: Almost every other aspect of your business should come second to payroll. Give up some assets, don't pay yourself, come up with new ways of financing, but pay your employees, otherwise your business could suffer very seriously.

title: Small Business Success Factors
text: **1. One of the most important factors for success in business is planning. ** This is probably the most important factor. Any business must begin with the development of a plan. Any plan must be as accurate as possible and take into account all possible deviations. Upon closer examination, it becomes clear what is needed for success in business. It is necessary to analyze the activities of competitors, to identify both positive and negative nuances of their work. When analyzing the work of others, it is worth identifying what you can learn from them, what needs to be improved, and what you can implement in your own business. **2. Organize work in such a way that each employee feels responsible for their work. ** It is worth distributing your own responsibility among subordinates, supporting the development of your employees in every possible way, involving them in new and new tasks. It is necessary to let your people express themselves; encourage their initiatives if they are useful for the business. **3. Organize relationships with staff correctly, build trusting relationships with both employees and customers.** **4. Organization of work. ** When everything in work is debugged to the smallest detail. Everything in the work is distributed among employees. Clearly and specifically. **5. Competent work with clients. ** Caring for clients, perceiving their opinions, satisfying their needs and desires. The highest level of services provided by your company. The trust of your company's customers is essential. Location of your customers. **6. Of course, care about your team, about your employees.** Even when applying for a job, discuss all the requirements and conditions; a written contract is preferable. The agreement will instill confidence in the potential employee. The principle: “Work and reward” should always work. You shouldn’t skimp on professionalism; it definitely pays off. Treat your employees with respect. Pay great attention to their training. The face of your business is your employees. Your success depends on them. In practice, these factors are rather paths to success that are quite easy to follow. The main thing is to start doing the right thing. There is no point in reinventing the wheel when the principle of its operation has been known to the whole world for a couple of hundred years. And remember, it’s better to use the experience of other people’s mistakes than your own.

title: Three elements of well-being
text: **1. Financial well-being.** Money helps you be a happier person, especially when you don't have to think about money. title: 5 reasons to start your own business
text: **1. New horizons.** The first reason to start your own business is that your own business will open new horizons for you and allow you to achieve great success in all aspects of life. When you work for hire, the company management takes credit for all your successes, and many people eventually stop developing professionally, preferring to do only the minimum that their bosses require of them. And this, in turn, negatively affects not only earnings and career growth, but also the development of a person as an individual. Thus, we get a vicious circle, which can only be broken by starting to work for ourselves. This will give new strength and motivation for hard work and development, help you become an proactive and intelligently risk-taking person, and ultimately lead to the expected success. **2. Freedom of action.** Running your own business gives people greater freedom of action. Having started your own business, you will work only for yourself - you no longer need to be afraid of being late for work, asking for time off from the clinic, or listening to moral lectures from your boss. You can set your own daily routine. Independence from an employer is what most people create their own business for. **3. Strengthening character.** Thirdly, running your own business will give you capital that will stay with you for life - this is your character. Having started your own business, you will have to take full responsibility for its well-being. You will become more proactive and decisive, knowing that there is no boss over you and you are the very person who is responsible for everything. On the other hand, you will own not only the responsibility, but also all the success and profits of your enterprise. **4. Implementation of your ideas.** Fourthly, if you have ideas and a desire to implement them, then your own business will help you successfully bring them to life and extract maximum profit from them. Many modern successful corporations began as small companies created by enthusiasts - people who wanted to achieve success and purposefully pursued their dreams. **5. A chance to change the world.** Owning your own business will allow you to change the world. When Steve Jobs invited Pepsi executive John Scali to head Apple, he told him: “Do you want to spend your life selling sweet water or get a chance to change the world?” If you have any ideas about how people should live, if you want to bring something new into the world, then the best way to do this is to stand at the helm of your own company.

title: How to save money while running a small business?
text: What are the biggest expenses in your business? While some of them (rent, utilities and insurance) are natural, others hinder business growth. Maybe you are struggling with late payments from large clients? Or did you hire unreasonably overpaid employees? Let's discuss ways to reduce the hidden costs of doing business... **1) Saving plan.** The main principle of minimizing expenses is to write a financial plan and stick to it. To learn how to do this, you can attend courses at local business groups, listen to advice, get support and the opportunity to share an effective strategy. If we consider savings in terms of the price of the product, the main thing is not to overdo it. After all, most customers want good value, not just the lowest price. In some cases, it makes sense to increase the price of one or two products and observe the results. Many entrepreneurs start their business from home. This is a good way to keep costs to a minimum. You may have to notify local authorities about your business. It should also be taken into account that this approach will increase the cost of paying for utilities. **2) Low-cost incentives for talented employees.** Hiring permanent staff is expensive for a small business; it all depends on the skills of the individual. To find top talent for your company, you must compete with large organizations that offer incentives such as additional health insurance or other benefits. The opportunity for career advancement is a real privilege for job seekers. Often employees are more concerned about this than additional bonuses. It is important to maintain the motivation and spirit of a particular employee. If your business is able to offer shares to its employees, this can be a good incentive for them to strive for self-improvement. **3) Dealing with late payments.** When a client owes you a debt, the question always arises: to maintain a good relationship or demand payment of the debt? But several such late payments can lead to an unstable financial situation for the enterprise. In this case, when concluding a contract, it is necessary to stipulate in writing possible sanctions for late payment. One of them is the calculation of interest on the amount of the debt incurred. **4) Use of outside expert assistance.** As a small business, with a limited number of employees, and without all the skills needed to grow your company, you can sometimes turn to outside help in areas such as marketing or business consulting. Of course, you need to weigh the costs against the potential benefits to your business. Modern marketing (for example, advertising on social networks) is more effective than traditional marketing (mailings, advertising in the press, etc.). Business consulting can help you develop a new business plan. But it's not cheap. An alternative option could be a mentor. As a rule, such people do their work at a lower cost to you than professional business consultants. The list of suggested tips is, of course, not exhaustive. But by following the basic rules of running a profitable business, your competitiveness in the modern market will increase significantly.

title: The power of small steps
text: We know that you need to set goals and this is a map of development in all areas of life. But keeping your attention on the goal is difficult because it is carried forward in time. What to do in this case? Focus on steps towards the goal! What are you dreaming about? Make a fortune, travel around the world, win an Oscar for best role in a movie? Such plans for 5, 10, 50 years ahead can be called global goals. They are so large-scale that it seems that even a lifetime is not enough to achieve them. But there are desires that don’t have to take years to achieve—local goals. Sometimes they bring you closer to a global dream or are even part of it and can become a regular procedure for achieving it. Set small intermediate goals, because small steps work. First you accomplish a small goal, then a larger goal, then an even larger goal, and eventually you achieve what you wanted. And don't scare yourself! For example, you set a goal to systematically engage in fitness. It often happens like this: you went to the gym a couple of times, then you missed it, then you made a few more attempts, but a little “cooled down” after the break, and then you gave up on it. I suggest planning like this: this week I will go to training twice. Only twice, and I’m already great! I'll go two more times next week. And in a month I will start planning proper nutrition. And just like that, without pushing yourself into strict limits, you will get the job done and receive satisfaction.

title: How to convince a person: 10 simple tips
text: Rules of persuasion: rhetoric, argumentation: 1. Never drive a person into a corner, be extremely polite and careful. 2. Use the above argument rotation carefully think through your speech. 3. text: 1. Never look back. Let go of your past. 2. Never treat time as if you have it forever. Always spend it wisely. 3. Never say more than necessary. 4. Never blame anyone for your mistakes and failures. 5. Never make vital decisions if you are in the mood. Both good and bad.

title: Stop doing this right now
text: **1. Sit still.** You can’t make money by sitting on the couch; you need to start working or studying. **2. Live in the past.** It happened and happened, the past cannot be changed. title: 10 reasons to work hard
text: 1. Set big goals and dreams that you want to achieve. title: Rules for independent development to achieve goals
text: 1. Clear your head of unnecessary debris. Bad habits, wasting time, stress, any stupid troubles and problems. Take them and forget about them. For new achievements you need a bright head. 2. title: How to get out of the money pit: 4 steps up
text: **1. Admit that there is a problem.** Many people are forced to constantly deny themselves everything. But they still run out of money at the most inopportune moment. Let's face it, you don't know how to handle your money properly. This skill is not given to us from birth; it needs to be nurtured and constantly cultivated. By themselves, only problems with money can arise. Financial well-being is always about the efforts you make, wise foresight and a proven sequence of actions. **2. Check your shopping list.** The days of scarcity are long gone. Nowadays, there is no need to buy in advance and stock up. Plan your shopping list so that you become truly rich, and not seem rich (by hanging yourself with shiny tinsel and newfangled gadgets). Remember that any purchase is a loss of money that you cannot get back. This does not mean at all that you need to become an ascetic monk: • Allow yourself to enjoy life and enjoy all the benefits of civilization: • But ostentatious purchases and excessive demonstration of one’s social status/success should be avoided. **3. Start a piggy bank.** You can save money on a deposit in a bank. The main thing is to start saving 10-20% of each of your earnings. This money will become your “financial cushion”. You can spend them in emergency cases: if you have lost your job or need urgent treatment. You shouldn’t waste this money on unplanned purchases (even if you really want to). **4. Learn to increase money.** Choose an investment strategy that suits you. Get into the good habit of buying currencies, stocks and other financial instruments every month. Don't expect quick results from your investments. If you are consistent, you will wait for the day when the amount of passive income from your financial capital will exceed the amount of your salary.

title: What not to waste time on
text: 1. Money for the sake of money. With them you can buy something that will allow you to enjoy life, surprise your family, travel... But when all your energy and time are devoted to making money, you lose the taste of life. 2. Unhappy relationships. There are a thousand reasons to stay in a relationship that brings nothing but resentment and dissatisfaction. But is it worth it? 3. Violence. Distance yourself from people who physically or psychologically abuse you. Also, analyze whether you are committing violence against yourself: unloved work, sacrificing your interests for the sake of loved ones, toxic communication... 4. Envy. This feeling is not as simple as anger or joy - envy is not so easy to control. This is precisely why she is dangerous. But there are antidotes for it, so work with this problem. 5. Nitpicking and petty quarrels. Sometimes you are so tired that any little thing can make you angry. Remember at these moments that a quarrel will take even more energy from you, and you are unlikely to benefit from it. 6. Existence "on draft". Nobody knows if tomorrow will come. Don't wait for a special moment to finally get a dog, see the ocean, or change careers. The future you will definitely not be happy that you are procrastinating today. 7. Lies and excuses. Trying to maintain your brand with lies, omissions and excuses, you yourself may not notice how you have lost yourself. Sometimes it's better to tell the inconvenient truth but stay true to yourself.

title: Don't stand still. Motivation for every day
text: 1. You need to continue moving in the chosen direction, not paying attention to the obstacles ahead. 2. You have to get up earlier than you want. 3. You need to give more than you get in return. 4. You need to care about others more than they care about you. 5. You have to fight even when you are exhausted and wounded. 6. title: How do you know when it’s time to close your startup?
text: It happens that a startup started working, demonstrated its viability, but never reached that scale. Which is what its creators were counting on. Sometimes this is a reason to adjust the business model. But it also happens that the best thing to do is close the project. If you're wondering whether your business can survive another year or whether it's better to cut it short and start working on a new project, ask yourself the following questions. 1. Can it be sold? Look at all your options before closing your business. If the problem is finances, think about it: is there a large company that will want to acquire your business in order to get your talent? Can you sell securities to raise investment capital? 2. Does your business partner share your point of view? Your partners may be more or less optimistic about the company's prospects. Perhaps it makes sense to agree on a deadline until which the project will live. If the project does not show better results up to this point, it makes sense to close it. 3. Can I try again? If, while working on a project, you have formed a team of specialists, but the project itself has actually become obsolete, perhaps it makes sense to do something else. Perhaps your next project will be much more successful than the previous one.

title: Happy clients mean successful business
text: First impressions always have a big impact. As an entrepreneur, the first step to providing quality customer service is to provide the same quality of service to your own employees. Do you treat your secretaries with the same courtesy as you treat a client who has come to sign a contract for a tidy sum? Do you start the day with a friendly “hello” to your colleagues? And are you ready to listen to your subordinates when they need it? The kindness you show in your team will triple and very quickly trickle down to the customer relationship level. **1. Lead by example.** Employees very often take their cues from their management. Make sure your managers are aware of how they treat employees. Often it is the “low-level” personnel who are the face of the company, an indicator for the client. And they will bring the positivity coming from management to their communication with consumers. **2. Provide a warm welcome.** When a client contacts your company, try to provide a friendly welcome and address him by name. The buyer will appreciate your attitude and will judge your company accordingly. A warm welcome will ensure interest in your business and will clearly encourage the client to do business with your company. **3. Think long term.** You can show your gratitude to your customers by sending cards for holidays and birthdays, personal discounts, and so on. This will make your buyer feel special and reduce the chance of a deal falling through by 75 percent. **4. Presumption of innocence.** At some point in your business, there may be complaints from customers, whether in person or online. Make sure you respond calmly to even the most violent statements. Give your employees instructions on what to say and how to act in such situations. Your responses to complaints must be consistent and timely. After all, then outsiders will be able to appreciate your company’s attempts to resolve the conflict peacefully even with the most dissatisfied client. And this will definitely play into your hands. **5. Seek feedback.** Arrange surveys for your clients and colleagues about your company, in their opinion: whether it copes with its tasks. Make an honest effort to resolve problems or implement suggestions. Maintaining a happy atmosphere among customers and employees is key to a successful business. Feedback does most of the work and saves you time thinking about what can and should be changed.

title: Failure is the key to success
text: Let's talk about failures. Most people (or maybe there are none here), including me, are accustomed to having a negative attitude towards failure. They are seen as a failure, proof that your plan was not successful or your ideas are not good enough. But the truth is that failure happens to everyone. One of the things that sets successful people apart is a true understanding of the power of failure. To achieve success, we must learn from mistakes and missteps along the way, and not give up and despair. To change your attitude towards failures, the following tips will help you and me. If you failed, then you tried. The best way to measure your progress in any area is to count the number of failures you have had. If you haven't failed, chances are you haven't tried very hard. Failure is the blacksmith's hammer that forges the sword of your success. If you really want to succeed at something, you have to fail at least a couple of times. If you look at all the great men and women in history, you will notice that they have one thing in common. They failed, and they failed often. Remember Thomas Edison. How many times did he make a mistake when choosing the filament material for his light bulb? There are different assumptions, but they are all within the “damn many” range.

title: 10 reasons why simpler is better
text: 1. When you get rid of chaos in your affairs, life will become clearer and easier to understand and manage. 2. There is more happiness in simple things - in a smile, in enjoying nature, in communicating with family and friends... These are things that we take for granted, but that should be truly appreciated. 3. By reducing chaos, you clear out areas you no longer need to worry about. The less clutter in your life, the calmer you feel and the better you sleep. 4. A simpler life frees up space for activities that energize you. 5. Getting rid of unnecessary things gives you time to be alone with yourself. Regular check-ins with yourself remind you of your priorities and help you maintain simplicity. 6. Simplicity improves work-life balance. Plus your relationship becomes more relaxed and open. 7. Bustiness no longer confuses you among a million priorities, and you become more confident in yourself. Confidence brings a positive outlook on things, which in turn contributes to more effective development. 8. A simple approach to life allows you to take failures philosophically, which means you remain committed to your goals no matter what. 9. The quality of life improves when you don't scatter your attention on everything. Order in your affairs gives you the resources to live life’s moments and eliminates the worry that you are not on time somewhere. 10. What you struggled with will turn out to be easier than you thought. The true reasons for everything that worried you will be revealed to you, and many problems will be resolved by themselves.

title: How to start a business again after failure
text: The world is full of stories about those who reached heights, but once fell from this very height: Disney, Spielberg, Stephen King. Their dizzying stories are known to us and to the whole world. But what to do here and now, finding yourself on the edge of an abyss where your dreams risk flying away? 1. Assess the situation, trying to avoid unnecessary emotions. What is done is done. We need to understand why the plan and the whole idea failed. Write down everything that went well and everything you did wrong. Think about what you can do differently next time if you encounter a bad situation again, what or who can help you cope better and ultimately solve this problem. Thorough work on mistakes is the key to locked doors, from past mistakes, and there is no way to repeat them again. Now the new foundation is the experience and knowledge gained in the past, use them to build your business, even if only the second time. 2. Separate your personality from your business. One of the main character traits of an entrepreneur is flexibility. When you started such a risky venture, you probably assumed that things could turn out like this. It is necessary to withstand the blow with dignity and quickly recover from such a mistake in business. Even if you are burned out and have lost a lot, self-confidence should not be on this list. An unsuccessful start to a business does not put an end to you as an entrepreneur. 3. Assess your attitude and mindset regarding the future prospects. It takes more than just a new plan and money to succeed. You need to show determination and a clear positive attitude. All successful world-famous businessmen, in addition to fabulous wealth, are united by optimism. Start by finding a product or service that you are truly passionate about and that fills a niche market. What can you offer? How can you stand out from the multitude of similar projects? Start developing your new business plan. Take the time to do market research and project your business idea into the larger picture. 4. Ask yourself another fundamental question: “Why does this business exist?” If you have a complete understanding of why and why you started all this, you will have a powerful driving force called “motivation”. This is a catalyst that can move things forward and find that very competitive uniqueness. 5. There are no ideal people. But it is in your power to assemble the perfect team. Create your dream team. Involve people who not only have extensive experience in the desired field, but also people of different ages, interests, ways of thinking, and temperament. This set of features will allow employees to complement each other more effectively. Take the time to carefully search and select the right people to fill every position your team needs. 6. Set clear short-term goals. Don't think a hundred steps ahead just yet. Set a time frame for achieving each plan and record the result. This is a roadmap for business. 7. Don't give up, keep trying again and again. In the end, the payback for your hard work will catch up with you, the main thing is not to give up.

title: Signs of High Potential
text: **1.Integrity.** Conscientious people commit to plans and carry them out to the letter. Such people know how to overcome their impulses and evaluate the wisdom of their decisions in the long term. Conscientiousness is considered one of the most important predictors of life outcomes. **2. Adaptability.** Everyone faces challenges, but people who are adaptable cope better under pressure without allowing it to negatively influence their behavior and decision-making. **3. Preparedness for uncertainty.** People with a high tolerance for uncertainty can explore many more points of view before coming to a decision, which means they are less dogmatic and more flexible in their opinions. **4. Curiosity.** Curiosity has previously been somewhat ignored by psychologists. However, recent research shows that a keen interest in new ideas has many benefits at work: it can mean you're more creative and flexible in using different techniques, helps you learn more easily, increases overall job satisfaction and protects against burnout. **5. Risk appetite.** Do you prefer to avoid potential unpleasant confrontations? Or will you move on, knowing that short-term discomfort will resolve the situation and bring long-term benefits? It's no surprise that the ability to handle difficult situations is critical to management positions. **6. Competitiveness.** There is a fine line between the desire for personal success and unhealthy envy of the success of others. Competitiveness at its best can be a powerful motivation that will force you not to stop at what you have achieved. But in the worst case scenario, it can lead to the destruction of the team.

title: 10 tips for self-improvement
text: **1. Meet the day wisely.** Get up earlier, do exercises, have breakfast. The earlier you get up, the more things you will have time to do during the day. **2. Make a schedule and stick to it.** Try to follow the schedule you created. This will allow you to solve more problems each day. Keep a notepad where you can write down current tasks. And at the end of the day, take stock of what was done and what could have been done better. **3. Don't forget about rest.** The best rest is a change of activity. Therefore, try to do varied work and relax during the day. After all, quality rest gives you even more strength to work and move forward. **4. Be generous.** Try to be kind and generous with other people. A smile, good advice, a friendly word - everything that you give into this world, you receive in multiplied quantities. **5. Accept what you cannot change.** There are things that cannot be changed. Don't waste your energy trying to make the world around you fit your needs. Learn to accept what you cannot change. **6. Learn new languages.** Learning foreign languages is one of the best ways to improve your understanding of your native language. In the process of studying, you give your brain a task, which ultimately allows it to work even better. **7. Eliminate routine.** Try to be a little more well-rounded person. Don't let your life become ordinary and boring. Try new things, gain new experience and new knowledge, expand your horizons! **8. Face your fears.** The more fears you have, the more difficult it becomes to live life to the fullest. It doesn't matter what you're afraid of, what matters is how you deal with your fears. Overcome your fears day by day, meter by meter expanding your comfort zone. **9. Live in the present.** It is not the goal that is important, but the journey to the goal. Don't forget about the present moment! Life doesn’t stand still, and it would be unreasonable to deprive yourself of the joy of living here and now for the sake of a momentary jubilation at the moment of achieving your goal. **10. Stop procrastinating.** Take control of your life! Think about what you want to achieve. And right now, decide to plan your work, rest and entertainment. If you intended to work today, but your mood is at zero and you don’t raise your hands, still force yourself to work. Anything is better than mindlessly sitting on the couch and watching TV.

title: Increased productivity. 7 tips.
text: 1. Plan your schedule. Plan everything to take control of your everyday life. Including time for joy and relaxation, of course. 2. Fill your calendar to the brim. Gaps in your schedule are time that you will waste 90% of the time. 3. Recharge. Most useful actions take away your energy, but there are also those that do the exact opposite - they charge and motivate. Include such responsibilities in your daily schedule. 4. Prioritize tasks. We often tend to do things that are not the most important on the agenda. As a result, by ignoring what is important, you feel depressed in the end. Do what you want most first. 5. Do the hardest thing first. This sets a positive mood for the whole day: you will always feel that there is little left. Do the hard stuff in the first 2 hours of the day. 6. Get up early. It doesn't have to be 4 or 5 a.m. wake up an hour earlier than your usual wake-up time. This is +1 hour for a productive routine. It will be nice if you spend it on solving complex problems. 7. Smile often and keep your back straight. Your movements generate emotions - check. A straight back, for example, makes you feel more confident. This means that solving problems will be easier. Experiment.

title: Top 5 qualities to achieve your goals that you should make your habits
text: **1. Set clear goals.** Just dreaming of getting rich or losing weight is futile. Instead of vague goals, you should set clear, specific and real ones. For example, lose 2 kilograms in a month. Change your job to another with a salary of at least a certain amount. Open an online store in six months. By setting clear goals that are limited in time, you will achieve them faster than just dreaming about positive changes and being in daydreams. Set clear goals and tie them to time. **2. Be patient.** Patience and perseverance are your main allies. Being patient is difficult, but sometimes necessary to achieve your dreams. Most goals are a marathon that requires persistence and patience over a long period of time. Ultimately, your persistence will be well rewarded if you did everything right. **3. Show discipline.** Discipline allows you to be consistent, not be distracted by various factors, and persistently pursue your goal. Discipline helps you get up early, be hardworking, and get things done. Social networks, the Internet, TV and laziness will interfere with you. But a disciplined person always achieves what he wants and achieves his goals. **4. Inner aspiration and drive.** Some people go with the flow, are unhappy with everything, but do not change anything. They are passive, and the fire in their eyes has faded. There are people who do not lose enthusiasm, aspiration and drive even after encountering difficulties. Stop being discouraged. Awaken the person you were in your early youth. Play sports and lead a healthy lifestyle, this will give you the energy you need. Inner drive will help you achieve your desired goals. **5. Be willing to learn.** You can always learn something new. Eagerly absorb knowledge and information. Don't stop developing and improving yourself. Upgrade your professional and internal qualities. Be ready to learn and fate will smile on you. Success comes to those who do everything they can for it. These excellent qualities for achieving goals will help if you understand them and start acting, and not like 90% of losers read and forget. Only 10% of those who read this article will begin to change their lives.

title: How to bring the matter to an end?
text: It is not always possible to finish a job that has been started. There are many reasons: lack of time, overwork, and even a dog that asks for a walk. Sometimes we are not able to finish a task because there is no person nearby who “motivates with a slap in the face.” Although you can do without it. For these reasons, many will consider themselves not disciplined enough. They will think that there are gifted people who can do it, but they can’t. The truth is that any person is capable of completing the task he takes on. You just need to follow these tips: 1. Abstract yourself from everything that interferes. Leave nearby only those things that contribute to your work. 2. It is important to anticipate possible obstacles and prepare for them in advance - try to look ahead and at least turn off notifications on your phone. 3. Take time to relax. It will save you from overload and reduce stress levels. 4. Break the work into parts. It is much easier to complete small tasks than one large one. 5. If your friends invited you to go for a walk, and you planned to work, don’t agree. Say you're busy and move on. 6. Don't rush to achieve your goal - slow down. You will immediately begin to work more meaningfully and purposefully - reducing the chances of making mistakes. There will be time to think about next steps. The next time you want to give up halfway, remember these points and continue moving towards your goal.

title: 8 rules to get more done
text: 1. Choose. Doing everything, doing everything, reading everything is a strategy from the last century. The world today is multi-layered and ambiguous - you need to choose, otherwise there is no other way. 2. Less control. Control is associated with an inflated sense of personal abilities and privileges, as well as with the inability to refuse and the desire to be good to everyone. This mission is impossible. 3. Manage your body pressure. That is, the need to respond to a message or close a notification as soon as possible. Doing small tasks gives you cheap dopamine. Don't become dependent on it. 4. Protect your concentration. When someone or something distracts you, the effect of imaginary importance occurs. But this comes at a huge cost, as it takes up to 23 minutes for the brain to regain focus and get back into flow. 5. Use tricks. Hemingway and Victor Hugo worked naked so that they would not be able to let anyone into their office or go out somewhere themselves. The artist who created the illustrations for "Tom Sawyer" covered his glasses with paper so that he would not be distracted by his peripheral vision. 6. Don't bring work home. Taking work home and always being in touch with everyone is a habit that only strokes your ego, but really interferes with real efficiency. Take care of your personal space and do not neglect rest. 7. Less fuss. By completing one task at a time, you will be less likely to experience procrastination. Remember that vanity cannot be controlled by vanity. 8. Don't confuse multitasking with multiprojecting. All people manage a large number of projects - family relationships, leisure time, diet, several work projects... And this is normal. The main thing is not to try to do everything at the same time.

title: 6 golden rules when interacting with others
text: 1. The surest way to win an argument is not to raise your voice, but to ask questions. Those that will allow your opponent to look at his arguments from a new angle and accept your point of view. This allows a person to notice his logical flaws. 2. One way to make a good impression is to call your interlocutor by name, instead of the usual impersonal “YOU.” It will subconsciously begin to seem to him that your attitude towards him is special. 3. Pay attention to what your interlocutor is saying. Great people discuss ideas, ordinary people discuss events, and small people discuss others. 4. If at work you are forced to constantly communicate with a large number of people whom you will never meet later, pay special attention to your appearance. Everyone is greeted by their clothes, so it's good when they match who you are - not the other way around. 5. If you need to convince someone else of something, use nonverbal techniques. One of them looks like this: you are standing, and your interlocutor is sitting next to you. This way his attention will be focused only on you, and the lower angle will force him to subconsciously listen more attentively than usual. 6. If they are going to scold you for something, use, again, nonverbal techniques. Does your boss scold you at a planning meeting? Sit as close to him as possible. It is subconsciously uncomfortable for a person to get angry and speak badly about someone who is sitting very close. His tone will be softer and more delicate.

title: Rules to help you
text: 1. Try not to impose yourself on people, and then it will become clear whether they really need you. 2. If you love two people at the same time, choose the second one. If you loved the first one, you wouldn't fall in love with the second one. 3. What others think of you should not concern you. 4. Those people who have forgiven most often and endured the longest usually leave unexpectedly and forever. 5. It doesn’t matter if you have no friends; it’s a disaster if they are fake and corrupt. 6. Talk less about your plans. 7. Never forgive cheating. Any betrayal is a comparison, a search for the best. Those who seek the best will never appreciate what they have... 8. Humans are 80% water. If a person has no dreams or goals in life, then he is just a vertical puddle. 9. Don't reject people who want to be with you. They may be the only ones who will stay with you in the most difficult moments of your life. 10. Treat people the way you want, treat them that way! Because there's no way in hell they'll treat you the same way you treat them!

title: 10 tips that will change your life
text: 1. Set goals, but don't get attached to them. 2. Plan your day. 3. Surround yourself with worthy people who will contribute to your realization. 4. Be true to your dream. 5. Work while enjoying. 6. Learn from a professional mentor who will help accelerate your professional growth. 7. Remember: no matter how good you do, someone will always be dissatisfied. It's unavoidable. 8. Small daily improvements lead to massive success. 9. Greet people first and smile at them. Only a strong and successful person can allow himself to be the first to show goodwill. 10. It's never too late to start a new business, introduce a new habit and take up a new hobby. Keep looking for things that will broaden your horizons.

title: 22 Daily Actions That Promote Personal Growth
text: 1. Be more observant. Keep track of everything that happens around you. The life around us is an excellent source for new experiences and new ideas. 2. Don't miss any idea that comes to your mind. Write down each one - even if you can’t implement it right away, you can come back to it later. 3. Take more from the people around you. There is a cycle of examples, ideas, words, relationships, mistakes, experience around you. Notice everything and use it to your advantage. 4. Always carry a book or magazine with you. In this way, you use to your advantage any period of time that could previously have been wasted - time on the road, queues, waiting for results. 5. Read at least 30 minutes every day. 6. Meditate. Make it a habit. This is both “brain gymnastics” and an excellent opportunity to bring clarity to your actions. 7. Try to analyze the past day every evening. What did you succeed and what didn’t? How did you have to make sure everything turned out perfect? 8. Drink more spring water. 9. Do more, think less. 10. Read collections of quotes often - this is a concentrated collection of wisdom. 11. Choose a “useful tip of the day” and apply it. 12. Keep personal “accounting”: write down all income and expenses. So at the end of the month the question does not arise: “Where did I manage to spend all the money?” You can track useless purchases that eat up your budget and avoid them: you can clearly imagine your real purchasing power. 13. Do something for the first time, or find a new way to do something mundane - for example, a more convenient and shorter way to work. It trains your mental abilities. 14. Read online materials with benefit, draw conclusions, and don’t just skim through them. 15. Use a timer more often when performing any task. 16. Learn to use guidelines, algorithms and techniques. Use the known ones, look for new ones. For example, master the hotkey editor - Keyboard Shortcut Editor, with which you can create your own and edit existing hotkeys. 17. Set goals, major and minor, immediate and long-term. 18. Wake up earlier every day. 19. Listen to educational or motivational programs if you are busy doing something that does not require full concentration. 20. Be friendly throughout the day - it inspires optimism and lifts your spirits. 21. Read a random Wikipedia article every day to get information about things you didn’t know about before. 22. Look for something funny or fun in life. This is the only way to truly enjoy it.
